turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hello there! How's your day treating you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm paying for way too many subscriptions.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That adds up fast. How many are we talking?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Three streaming services, a gym, and some app I forgot about.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Which one could you cancel today without really missing it?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, thirteen seconds. Then ask again.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: So, which subscription gets the axe first?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, one of the streaming ones. I only watch one show on it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then cancel it now and pick it back up for a month when the new season comes out.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Right, next thing. I want a game I can play with my grandkids. They're four and six.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Wonderful. Outfoxed is a sweet cooperative game for that age, everyone works together to catch a sneaky fox.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The four year old can't read yet.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's fine, it uses pictures only. Another favorite is Hoot Owl Hoot, which is all colors.
